thread:
Anna (docs): FYI I'm opening a PR to update the Nebula3b model card with embedding-sharding guidance. Need a short migration snippet for customers who use the old 'embed_shard_key' param (we're deprecating it in favor of embed_shard_index). Also want bench numbers for recommended shard counts.

Priya (eng-ml): Thanks. Short summary: prefer shard_count=4 for typical 1536-dim vectors on 16GB GPUs. Fallback to single-shard for small workloads. We'll add a note about increased cold-starts when shards > 8.

Leo (bench): Quick numbers to include: 1) shard_count=1 median latency 45ms (single GPU), 2) shard_count=4 median 28ms p95 120ms under concurrent 32qps, 3) shard_count=8 reduces p50 slightly but p99 increases due to coordination. I'll attach CSV in the PR.

Anna (docs): Great — can someone draft a minimal JS + curl example showing how to request a specific embed_shard_index and how to migrate from embed_shard_key? Keep it tiny.

Max (sdk): Draft JS snippet:
```js
// migrating from embed_shard_key to embed_shard_index
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'nebula3b', input: ['one','two'], embed_shard_index: 0, shard_count: 4 });
console.log(resp.data);
```

Max (sdk): Curl fallback example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"nebula3b","input":["one","two"],"embed_shard_index":0,"shard_count":4}'
```

Anna (docs): Nice. Add a 1-line Python equivalent and a migration note: "If you used embed_shard_key, map your keys to stable integers and set embed_shard_index accordingly; keys will be ignored after deprecation date."

Max (sdk): Python snippet: 
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_API_KEY'))
client.embeddings.create(model='nebula3b', input=['one','two'], embed_shard_index=0, shard_count=4)
```

Priya (eng-ml): Small technical callout: when shard_count>1 we route inputs by shard_index; recommend deterministic mapping (hash mod shard_count). Add sample mapping line to migration steps.

Anna (docs): I'll add mapping example: `shard_index = murmurhash(id) % shard_count` and a short example script. Also will call out that Console exposes a shard health view.

legal-bot: Reminder: embedding telemetry or mapping keys must not include raw PII. Docs should use hashed IDs or synthetic examples.

Anna (docs): Got it — will add legal blurb and sample hashing snippet.

Leo (bench): Also add a short 'cost tradeoff' note: more shards = more parallelism but higher GPU-hours. Include bench CSV link.

Max (sdk): One more: add compatibility note for older SDKs that don't accept embed_shard_index. Suggest upgrade to SDK >= 2.4.0 or use the raw HTTP curl. I'll add that to the PR description.

Anna (docs): Perfect. I'll open PR now with: migration checklist, JS/python/curl snippets, shard mapping example, bench blurb + CSV link, compatibility note, and privacy line. Assigning reviewers @Priya and @Max. ETA: EOD.

ci-bot: docs-ci: lint check started for PR #4187.

Max (sdk): Quick QA: can we also include a tiny troubleshooting bullet for mismatched shard_count (users will see 400 if shard_index >= shard_count)?

Priya (eng-ml): Yes add error message example and recommended debug steps (check mapping function, shard_count env in consumer).

deploy-bot: Preview ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood.inference/docs/model-cards/nebula3b-embed-sharding-migration (expires in 7 days)

Anna (docs): Thanks team — pinging for reviews. Will merge after approvals. :rocket:
